{{Quote|Essentially a flat ellipsoid with micro-repulsorlift turbines placed along the bottom surface, slicers are an open-air, 'no hands' approach to personal skimming.|An excerpt from ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="FantasticTech" />}}
'''Micro-repulsorlift turbines''' were a type of [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generator]] used in [[sky slicer]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] distributed by [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]]. The turbines were placed along the bottom surface of the swoop to provide lift for the vehicle. They were mentioned in the sky slicer's entry in the fiftieth anniversary issue of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]'', released at some point between<ref name="FantasticTech" /> [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' states that the [[in-universe]] fiftieth anniversary issue of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]'' was published between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], respectively.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Micro-repulsorlift turbines were mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Rick D. Stuart]].<ref name="FantasticTech" />
